Body.Content:
Business value

Field service work often happens in environments where network quality changes throughout the day. Technicians may move between connected, low-connectivity, intermittent, and offline conditions while still needing the mobile app to remain dependable.

Mobile offline is being improved to better detect and respond to changing network conditions. More adaptive sync behavior can help reduce disruptions, avoid unnecessary retries, and improve reliability when users move across different connectivity states.

Feature detail

This update improves how mobile offline detects and responds to weak, intermittent, or limited connectivity. Sync behavior will become more adaptive so the app can better determine when to sync, when to pause, and when to reduce unnecessary work.

The capability is intended to help Field Service Mobile provide a more dependable offline experience in real-world field environments. It focuses on sync behavior and connectivity response, while administrators and makers remain responsible for designing offline profiles that match field usage, data volume, and business requirements.

GA date: January CY2027
